title.es: QYSEA: Robótica submarina para una acuicultura más eficiente y de alta precisión

summary.en: Since 2016, QYSEA, a company based in Shenzhen, China, has been developing intelligent systems for underwater tasks that integrate ROV (Remotely Operated Vehicle) platforms, modular payloads and task-specific tools, together with navigation and positioning technologies, artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted software and digital workflows that optimize aquatic work. title.es: Club Innovación Acuícola y UAI anuncian diplomado de IA para decisiones críticas en salmonicultura
title.en: Aquaculture Innovation Club and UAI announce AI diploma for critical decisions in salmon farming
title.no: Aquaculture Innovation Club og UAI lanserer KI-diplom for kritiske beslutninger i lakseoppdrett

summary.es: El Club Innovación Acuícola y la Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez (UAI) anunciaron el diplomado de IA en salmonicultura. Su nombre completo es Diplomado en Inteligencia Artificial Aplicada a Decisiones Críticas en Salmonicultura. La iniciativa busca fortalecer las capacidades de ejecutivos y profesionales para incorporar nuevas tecnologías en la gestión y la toma de decisiones del sector. El programa será presentado oficialmente el 20 de noviembre en Santiago. Comenzará sus actividades académicas el 18 de mayo de 2027, en modalidad online en vivo. La iniciativa surge de una premisa central. La transformación que provoca la inteligencia artificial no depende solo de disponer de nuevas tecnologías. P
summary.en: The Aquaculture Innovation Club and Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez (UAI) announced the AI diploma program in salmon farming. Its full name is Diploma in Artificial Intelligence Applied to Critical Decisions in Salmon Farming. The initiative seeks to strengthen the capabilities of executives and professionals to incorporate new technologies into management and decision-making in the sector. The program will be officially presented on November 20 in Santiago. Academic activities will begin on May 18, 2027, in a live online format. The initiative stems from a central premise: the transformation caused by artificial intelligence does not depend only on having new technologies. P...
summary.no: Aquaculture Innovation Club og Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez (UAI) har kunngjort et KI-diplom i lakseoppdrett. Det fulle navnet er Diplom i kunstig intelligens anvendt på kritiske beslutninger i lakseoppdrett. Initiativet skal styrke ledere og fagpersoners evne til å ta i bruk ny teknologi i styring og beslutningstaking i næringen. Programmet presenteres offisielt 20. november i Santiago. Den akademiske virksomheten starter 18. mai 2027, som direktesendt nettundervisning. Initiativet bygger på en sentral forutsetning: Omstillingen som kunstig intelligens medfører, avhenger ikke bare av tilgang til ny teknologi. P...

summary.en: Bringing the reality of the aquaculture industry to technical education and opening spaces for direct learning in operations were the focus of the visit by Duoc UC Puerto Montt students to Blumar's Remote Feeding Room, where they learned how artificial intelligence is integrated for biomass monitoring. The activity is part of the course "Introduction to Aquaculture Technologies", taught by DUOC UC in partnership with SalmonChile and promoted together with partner companies such as Blumar, Innovex, Akva, Multi X and Kran to connect students with the reality of the sector through the direct participation of industry professionals. title.en: [MOST READ ON MONDAY] Industry groups reject international campaign that excludes farmed salmon from restaurants

summary.es: Los gremios salmonicultores chilenos cuestionaron una campaña internacional que busca excluir el salmón de cultivo de las cartas de restaurantes. La iniciativa, denominada “Off the Table” , es impulsada por WildFish, una organización benéfica con base en Escocia. La campaña derivó en una carta suscrita por más de 120 chefs y representantes del mundo gastronómico. Sus firmantes se comprometieron a no servir salmón de cultivo en sus establecimientos. Frente a esta iniciativa, representantes de SalmonChile y del Consejo del Salmón manifestaron sus reparos. summary.en: Chilean salmon farming associations challenged an international campaign that seeks to exclude farmed salmon from restaurant menus. The initiative, called "Off the Table", is promoted by WildFish, a Scotland-based charity. The campaign led to a letter signed by more than 120 chefs and representatives of the culinary world, who pledged not to serve farmed salmon in their establishments. In response, representatives of SalmonChile and the Salmon Council voiced their objections. Both associations defended the product's nutritional contribution, its presence in international markets and the role of salmon farming in...

Initiativet, kalt «Off the Table», drives av WildFish, en skotskbasert veldedig organisasjon. title.es: SalmonChile releva potencial de la acuicultura para invertir en ENADE 2026

summary.en: At the business gathering, the association highlighted salmon farming's growth opportunities, in a session where Finance Minister Jorge Quiroz and former minister Juan Carlos Jobet discussed the contribution of productive sectors to the country's economic development. title.es: Cuatro empresas de Los Lagos participan en feria de productos del mar en China
title.en: Four Los Lagos companies take part in seafood fair in China
title.no: Fire selskaper fra Los Lagos deltar på sjømatmesse i Kina

summary.es: Pure Nature Foods, Salmones de Chile, Pacific Star y Pesquera Catalunya integran el pabellón nacional coordinado por ProChile en China Fisheries & Seafood Expo 2026, que finaliza este viernes 30 de octubre en Qingdao. La participación coincide con un crecimiento de 35,1% de las exportaciones regionales a China. La entrada Cuatro empresas de Los Lagos participan en feria de productos del mar en China se publicó primero en Mundoacuicola .
summary.en: Pure Nature Foods, Salmones de Chile, Pacific Star and Pesquera Catalunya are part of the national pavilion coordinated by ProChile at China Fisheries & Seafood Expo 2026, which ends this Friday, October 30 in Qingdao. The participation coincides with a 35.1% growth in regional exports to China. The post Four Los Lagos companies take part in seafood fair in China was first published on Mundoacuicola.
summary.no: Pure Nature Foods, Salmones de Chile, Pacific Star og Pesquera Catalunya er med i det nasjonale paviljongen koordinert av ProChile på China Fisheries & Seafood Expo 2026, som avsluttes fredag 30. oktober i Qingdao. Deltakelsen faller sammen med en vekst på 35,1 prosent i regionens eksport til Kina. Innlegget Fire selskaper fra Los Lagos deltar på sjømatmesse i Kina ble først publisert på Mundoacuicola.

summary.es: Un nuevo centro de cosecha de salmones en Magallanes busca acompañar las proyecciones de crecimiento de la salmonicultura en la región. Lo impulsa Abick. La iniciativa considera una inversión de US$6 millones. Recientemente obtuvo la aprobación de la Comisión Regional de Uso del Borde Costero (CRUBC) para avanzar en su concesión marítima . Contempla la operación de un pontón que permitirá la descarga directa de peces vivos desde wellboats. Se hará mediante un sistema de salmoducto y bombeo hacia la planta de faenamiento. Posteriormente, los peces serán descargados post desangre en Fish
summary.en: A new salmon harvest center in Magallanes seeks to support the growth projections of salmon farming in the region. It is promoted by Abick. The initiative involves an investment of US$6 million. It recently obtained approval from the Regional Commission for the Use of the Coastal Border (CRUBC) to advance its maritime concession. The project will be located in Bahía Puerto Riquelme, on the Antonio Varas Peninsula, in the commune of Puerto Natales. It includes operating a pontoon that will allow the direct unloading of live fish from wellboats, using a salmon pipeline and pumping system to the processing plant.
